She further argued that the respondent No. 2 filed an application under Section 156(3) of the Cr.P.C.,
before learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Basna, District Mahasamund (C.G.) and on the basis of aforesaid application learned JMFC on 22.06.2023 issued memo to Police Station Basna to registered FIR (specially under Section 498-A) against the petitioners.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that on the basis of memo of learned JMFC, Police Station Basna registered the FIR against the petitioners under Sections 498-A, 377, 323, 506, 354 &
34 of the IPC and Sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 (for short, 'Act of 1961').

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class, Basna, District Mahasamund
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: She also submits that after investigation Police filed charge-sheet against the petitioner on 11.07.2023 and Criminal Case No. 504 of 2023 under Sections 498-A, 377, 323, 506, 354 and 34 of the IPC and Sections 3 & 4 of the Act of 1961.
It is further contended by the learned counsel for the petitioners that just after 21 days of marriage,
respondent No. 2 run away from her husband's house with her beloved, namely, Jagbandhu Das Vaishnav along with all the jewellery and other belongings.
The missing person report was lodged by petitioner No. 1 at Police Station Abhanpur on 01.06.2022.
Thereafter, on 04.06.2022, respondent No. 2 was recovered and her statement was recorded by Police.

She also contended that even after marriage, the respondent No. 2 wanted to live with her beloved, but when he refused to marry her then respondent No. 2 on 29.08.2022 registered an FIR No. 356 of 2023 against him under Section 376(2)(n) of the IPC for committing sexual intercourse with the respondent No. 2 on the pretext of marriage.

Learned State counsel submits that in compliance of Court's order dated 07.02.2024, the case diary of Crime No. 356 of 2022 is placed on record and in the said case charge-sheet had already been submitted.
Learned State counsel is directed to send back the case diary of Crime No. 356 of 2022 to the concerned Investigation Officer so that the matter be proceeded in accordance with law.
Issue notice to the respondents by ordinary as well as registered posts.
Learned State counsel appears and accepts notice on behalf of respondent No. 1, therefore, issuance of notice to respondent No. 1, is dispensed with.

Process fee be paid within a week only for respondent No. 2.
Notice be made returnable in four weeks.

Two weeks' time is granted to the learned State counsel as well as respondent No. 2 to file their reply- affidavit and thereafter, one week's time is granted to the learned counsel for the petitioners to file rejoinder affidavit.
List this matter thereafter.
